messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "too much thyroid hormone can cause irregular heartbeat"
set: ["too much thyroid hormone can cause irregular heartbeat", "too much thyroid hormone can cause angina", "too much thyroid hormone can cause other heart problems", "can cause serious and life-threatening irregular heartbeat", "irregular heartbeat", "Thyroid hormone", "too much sedation", "taking more thyroid hormone than your body needs can cause an overactive thyroid", "fast or irregular heartbeat", "slow or irregular heartbeat", "drinking too much alcohol", "Passing too much fluid", "taking too much may cause serious or life-threatening side effects", "difference between too little and too much is small", "drugs that affect thyroid hormone levels", "irregular heartbeat is most commonly atrial fibrillation"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
